task.speaker: client
task.text:
Marissa,

Development work in preparation for launch has kept me occupied for the past few days, hence the gap in communication. I would now like to resume the website work, as it will clearly be integral to the launch. The areas requiring review and planning are:

1\. Finalize the assets and layout for the initial landing-page design, including its responsive behavior.

2\. Establish the basis for later website pages: whether they share common headers and footers, use "dark mode," or have a complementary "light mode" style. I mean separate styling, not something users can switch.

3\. Define guidance and/or rules for responsive behavior in general.

4\. Work through the layout and styling of the dashboard shell and "canvas."

For context, I have attached screens from the secure signup and login flow, which uses AWS Cognito. They currently have AWS default styling, although several self-styling options are available.

While some of this belongs within the current job, other parts sit outside its scope. What approach would you recommend from here? Would a meeting or video call be the best way to discuss it?

Derek
